body:
Checked `gradle tasks`, looks good, for `app:bundle`


```
alex@MacM1 java % pwd
/Users/alex/Develop/godot-github/platform/android/java
alex@MacM1 java % ./gradlew tasks --all | grep 'app:bundle'
```

<details><summary>app:bundle*</summary>

```
app:bundle - Assemble bundles for all the variants.
app:bundleDebug - Assembles bundles for all Debug variants.
app:bundleDev - Assembles bundles for all Dev variants.
app:bundleMono - Assembles bundles for all Mono variants.
app:bundleRelease - Assembles bundles for all Release variants.
app:bundleStandard - Assembles bundles for all Standard variants.
app:bundleMonoDebug - Assembles bundle for variant monoDebug
app:bundleMonoDebugClassesToCompileJar
app:bundleMonoDebugClassesToRuntimeJar
app:bundleMonoDebugResources
app:bundleMonoDev - Assembles bundle for variant monoDev
app:bundleMonoDevClassesToCompileJar
app:bundleMonoDevClassesToRuntimeJar
app:bundleMonoDevResources
app:bundleMonoRelease - Assembles bundle for variant monoRelease
app:bundleMonoReleaseClassesToCompileJar
app:bundleMonoReleaseClassesToRuntimeJar
app:bundleMonoReleaseResources
app:bundleStandardDebug - Assembles bundle for variant standardDebug
app:bundleStandardDebugClassesToCompileJar
app:bundleStandardDebugClassesToRuntimeJar
app:bundleStandardDebugResources
app:bundleStandardDev - Assembles bundle for variant standardDev
app:bundleStandardDevClassesToCompileJar
app:bundleStandardDevClassesToRuntimeJar
app:bundleStandardDevResources
app:bundleStandardRelease - Assembles bundle for variant standardRelease
app:bundleStandardReleaseClassesToCompileJar
app:bundleStandardReleaseClassesToRuntimeJar
app:bundleStandardReleaseResources

```
</details>

Previously, the tasks were executed without `Mono` / `Standard`.
Seems to be working as expected, `mono` output is no longer built when exporting from non-mono editor (which also speed up gradle export).
